svg.title: Voice RAG
svg.desc: Voice RAG (AnshulMohanty/HH_Goa). Ask out loud. Get a quote, not a vibe. Voice-first retrieval with a 200 ms budget. The retrieval core runs in 3.4 ms, and the README shows exactly where the other 1.4 seconds go.
